title: Lantern Drift
lead: Hold either side or use ← → to drift. Catch embers to keep your flame alive.
move: Hold the left or right half of the sky to drift. On a keyboard, use ← → or A / D.
star: Catch gold stars to gather wishes.
spark: Catch embers to refuel your flame.
danger: Rain weakens your flame. Avoid wires, birds and tiled eaves.
